name: Chief of Staff
description: Coordinates the Office of the CEO within the Executive Office, driving executive agendas, cross-divisional initiatives, and leadership communications. Manages priority-setting, meeting cadence, and follow-through on decisions to keep the enterprise operating rhythm on track.

name: Claims Adjuster
description: Performs day-to-day claim handling across the Claims value stream, evaluating liability, documenting decisions, and managing denials with appeal follow-ups. Coordinates emergency mitigation, structured settlement placement, and vendor network routing, ordering IMEs when evidence is insufficient and keeping the claims platform and claim file fully documented.

name: Claims Analyst
description: Owns high-volume analytical work across the Claims value stream, spanning field investigations, reserve setting, and settlement strategy development. Adjusts and documents reserves on new evidence, runs fraud-indicator screens, manages recovery posting and collections ageing, and supports quality through calibration sessions and re-audits in the claims management platform.

name: Claims Coordinator
description: Coordinates claim workflow routing across the Claims value stream, monitoring routing exceptions and rebalancing misrouted claims. Supports liability evaluations, denial management with appeal follow-ups, structured settlement placement, and vendor network maintenance, keeping decisions logged and file owners notified in the claims management platform.

name: Claims Director / Manager
description: Leads claims operations across the Claims value stream, directing liability evaluations, investigation plan development, and structured settlement placement. Oversees workflow routing, vendor network management, and lien and Medicare obligation compliance, assigning field investigations and ensuring decisions are documented in the claims management platform.

name: Claims Examiner
description: Owns end-to-end claim examination across the Claims value stream, setting and adjusting reserves, running fraud-indicator screens, and directing field investigations. Manages settlement strategy, reopened claims, lien obligations, and recovery posting, documenting reserve rationale and supporting calibration sessions within the claims management platform.

name: Claims Intake Rep
description: Performs first-notice-of-loss intake for the Claims value stream, routing new claims and monitoring exceptions to rebalance misrouted files. Supports liability documentation, denial logging with appeal follow-ups, and emergency mitigation, keeping the claims management platform and claim file repository current.

name: Claims Processor
description: Performs high-volume claim processing across the Claims value stream, setting up benefit payment schedules, posting recoveries, and managing collections ageing. Handles reserve adjustments with documented rationale, reopened claims, and lien obligations, applying fast-track templates and fraud screens within the claims management platform.

name: Claims Quality Assurance / Training Manager
description: Oversees claims quality and training across the Claims value stream, monitoring routing exceptions, liability documentation, and denial handling for adherence. Tracks retained asset account compliance and reports it to regulators on schedule, driving workflow routing quality and denial management standards through the claims management platform.

name: Clearance Specialist
description: Performs clearance and governance support across the Underwriting value stream, screening reinsurance treaties for retention and preparing quarterly and annual bordereaux. Supports policy binding, mid-term endorsements, and appetite guideline management, validating appetite changes against capital and reinsurance terms and reporting portfolio status to committee.

name: Cloud Architect
description: Owns platform architecture across the Technology & Engineering value stream, with additional Data & AI responsibilities. Designs the observability platform, discovers service-to-infrastructure dependencies, and drives resilience improvements such as redundancy and self-healing, while supporting incident eradication, hypercare, and access-policy-compliant service request fulfillment via the ITSM and IAM platforms.

name: Cloud Cost Analyst
description: Owns FinOps governance across the Technology & Engineering value stream, producing rolling cloud spend forecasts, chargeback reporting reconciled to the ledger, and executive cost trend dashboards. Drives resource optimization through rightsizing, off-hours scheduling, and tag remediation, and builds the bottom-up annual cloud budget with unit economics by team.

name: Cloud Engineer
description: Owns cloud infrastructure provisioning and Kubernetes platform engineering across the Technology & Engineering value stream. Authors reusable IaC modules, validates provisioning requests against landing zone governance standards, and builds the centralized observability platform, while engineering network connectivity, private endpoints, CI/CD pipelines, and data platform disaster recovery and security.
